name: manual_c93918
claim: Do every check that can refuse an attempt before claiming a once-only marker or any other irreversible side effect. Claiming the marker first meant a mistyped evaluator digest consumed the single permitted attempt and left no record. The refusal paths now run first, and the claim is the last step before work.
conditions: once marker ordering validate before claim side effect

decisions.notes: 2026-11-17: dry_cycle with a bad digest returned invalid-trace and the next call with a good digest returned already-ran; after reordering, the good call succeeds and a regression test covers it.
